tools.name: current_date
tools.description: Get the current date and local time in Europe/Madrid. Free; evaluated live for every call.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the Vextorium catalog of 242 paid data services by keywords (e.g. 'crypto price', 'sanctions', 'ECB rates', 'earthquakes'). Free. Returns service ids, descriptions and prices.

tools.name: service_details
tools.description: Details of one Vextorium service: what it does, its price in USDC, the JSON input it accepts (schema) and an example. Free.

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Run any Vextorium service with its parameters and get the JSON result. Paid per call in USDC via x402 (price shown by service_details); invalid input or a failed upstream source is not charged.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the Vextorium catalog of 507 paid data services by keywords (e.g. 'wallet balance solana', 'sanctions', 'ECB rates', 'polymarket'). Free. Returns service ids, descriptions and prices." → after: "Search the Vextorium catalog of 242 paid data services by keywords (e.g. 'crypto price', 'sanctions', 'ECB rates', 'earthquakes'). Free. Returns service ids, descriptions and prices."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
